1.explanation: 1. Import the Carbon React TimePicker and TimePickerSelect components.  2. Render three instances of <TimePicker>: one with size="sm", one with no size (default), and one with size="lg".  3. Add identical <TimePickerSelect> children for AM/PM and timezone.  4. Observe in the browser (or by measuring with the dev‐tools ruler) that all three pickers remain at 40 px tall, showing that the small and large variants aren’t wired up in the component or stylesheet.
1.bug_scenario: The TimePicker component only renders at the default 40 px height, even when you pass size="sm" (expecting 32 px) or size="lg" (expecting 48 px). In the screenshot you can see three pickers—all labeled “Choose a time”—with pink callouts at 32 px, 40 px, and 48 px. However, when you try to use the new size variants, the small and large pickers still render at the default 40 px height because the size prop and corresponding CSS modifiers are not hooked up.
